Intro

Karo Healthcare, a dynamic and growing personal-care retail company, is all about making smart choices for everyday healthcare. With a wide-ranging portfolio across seven categories, including medical products, we own and sell over 80 brands in about 90 countries. Our portfolio includes such brands as E45, Pevaryl, Lamisil, Nutravita, Decubal, and many others. Our core belief in empowering people to make intelligent health decisions drives our growth strategy, blending organic expansion and M&A.

Join us at Karo Healthcare on our exciting journey. We're currently looking for a Key Account Manager, Pharmacy for our office in Copenhagen.

What's in it for you?

This is a high-impact commercial role where you will take real ownership of key pharmacy partnerships, influence how our brands win in-store, and work closely with Sales, Marketing, E-commerce and external partners. You'll join a fast-moving international business where ideas turn into action quickly and where there is plenty of room to shape the role, grow your commercial expertise and make a visible impact.

What you'll be doing

• Develop and execute customer strategies for key pharmacy accounts together with the Sales Director, Brand Managers and E-commerce KAM

• Plan, submit, execute and evaluate trade campaigns together with internal teams and external agencies.

• Build, strengthen and grow strategic relationships with existing pharmacy partners

• Lead annual customer planning, commercial negotiations and account development

• Identify commercial opportunities that drive sustainable growth, profitability and sell-out performance

• Ensure customer campaigns, pricing, assortment, product information and commercial activities are implemented accurately and on time

• Act as a commercial sparring partner to Brand Managers to create best-in-class brand visibility and in-store execution

• Manage key wholesaler processes, including maintenance of pricing, assortment and customer information

• Take ownership of the CRM system supporting pharmacy sales representatives and help ensure effective commercial execution of key pharmacy accounts

• Use customer, market and commercial insights to continuously improve performance, service levels and ways of working

Requirements

• Master's degree, professional bachelor's degree or equivalent education in a relevant field

• Solid experience from a commercial, sales or key account management environment

• Being structured and managing customer processes diligently and promptly

• Experience working with B2C customers, ideally within FMCG, consumer healthcare, pharmaceuticals, retail or another fast-moving industry

• Experience with the Danish pharmacy market or consumer healthcare sector is an advantage

• Strong commercial mindset with experience in customer negotiations, account planning and business development

• Excellent relationship management and stakeholder management skills

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Entrepreneurial and hands-on mindset with a strong "go-do" attitude

• Comfortable taking ownership, working independently and building structure in a dynamic environment

• Commercially and financially minded, with the ability to balance customer opportunities with profitable growth

• Able to maintain a strong overview while managing multiple priorities in a changing international business

Benefits

• Opportunity to create, grow, and encourage

• Apart from a competitive salary pack, there are lots of growth opportunities to meet your personal ambitions

• Flexible schedule and life work balance

• Responsibility for exciting and challenging projects that have a direct, visible impact on our customers and the industry

• Very positive work environment in a young, international, and motivated team

• Start-up spirit while being a part of the large international organization with strong values

Karo Healthcare has a Diverse & Inclusive environment. We are looking for qualified candidates irrespective of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, religion, national origin, disability or age.

Nordic Laboratories

Senior Bookkeeper (Copenhagen based)

Overview:

Nordic Laboratories is part of Nordic Group, a purpose-driven organisation dedicated to improving health globally through functional medicine and a personalised approach to health. As a world-renowned functional medicine brand, Nordic Laboratories supports health practitioners worldwide with genetic and functional testing, as well as having a nutraceutical brand.

We are looking for an experienced, full time Senior Bookkeeper to take ownership of day-to-day finance operations for our busy finance team in central Copenhagen. This is a senior, autonomous role for someone who can run the books end-to-end and act as a trusted right hand to finance leadership.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:

• Own and manage day-to-day bookkeeping across multiple entities, maintaining accurate and audit-ready financial records

• Maintain up-to-date financial data using Uniconta accounting software, including oversight of chart of accounts and posting standards

• Process and oversee accounts payable, ensuring timely vendor payments and enforcing approval and cut-off procedures

• Manage accounts payable related to operations and collections, in accordance with company policy

• Manage and facilitate payments to staff, contractors, and suppliers in line with the company's approval processes

• Reconcile bank statements, credit card transactions, and intercompany accounts across group entities

• Lead the preparation of budgets, forecasts, and monthly management reports for review by finance leadership

• Take ownership of VAT submissions (including cross-border and OSS reporting), year-end audits, and tax compliance

• Review and strengthen internal financial controls and accounting policies, identifying process improvements

• Mentor and review the work of junior bookkeeping or finance assistant staff, acting as a first point of escalation

Special Requirements:

• Strong working knowledge of Uniconta, or proven ability to master new accounting software quickly

• Deep understanding of bookkeeping principles, financial procedures, and month-end/year-end close processes

• Experience with VAT, including cross-border VAT (Split VAT, OSS/Union Scheme) and Lønsumsafgift, is a strong advantage

• Prior experience reconciling accounts for international or multi-entity companies

• Familiarity with IFRS and general audit preparation

• High attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record keeping

• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing deadlines across entities

• Analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret financial data, identify discrepancies, and recommend fixes

• Comfortable working independently and taking ownership, while collaborating closely with the wider finance and leadership team

• Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to liaise with senior stakeholders and external partners

Package:

• Salary between 35,000 - 38,000, based on experience and qualifications

• Location: Copenhagen

• Benefits: Opportunity to gain experience from our global network and spend time working internationally

• Support and training from our experienced team

• Discounts on functional medicine tests and supplements

• Fun, sociable team with regular events and activities

We are looking to appoint this role as soon as possible

To apply for this role please submit your CV along with a covering letter to  jobs@nordicgroup.eu

The short version

A venture-backed Danish medical imaging company is hiring its first dedicated AI/ML scientist. The company has a CE-marked product already in clinical use and is now building the next generation of diagnostic tools on top of the imaging data that product generates.

This is not a role where you inherit a dataset and a backlog. The data largely does not exist yet. Part of this job is going out to hospitals, working alongside clinicians, and finding out whether the data they hold actually contains the answer to the question they are asking. The other part is turning that into methods and working prototypes.

If you want a clean pipeline and a defined problem, this is the wrong role. If you want to define the problem, it is close to ideal.

The company

Venture-backed, Danish, around 40 people, with offices in Copenhagen. The technology is PET-based functional imaging that produces quantitative measurements rather than pictures alone — the ability to put a number on physiological function, not just describe what an image looks like.

The first product is CE-marked and in clinical use, with a pivotal trial running and a regulatory submission planned in the United States. Quantification is the core of the company’s value: it is what competitors do not offer, and it is the thing this role is hired to extend.

The company is named at first conversation. We have not put it in writing here.

The mission

The imaging data is the future product line. Today the company measures blood flow in the heart. The question is what else the same data can answer – in cardiology, in neurology, and beyond – and what methods are needed to get there.

You are hired to answer that. You will be the company’s dedicated AI/ML voice, joining a software team of eight and reporting to the Head of Software. You will work across R&D, clinical development, quality and regulatory.

Concretely, the first twelve months look like this:

• Building working relationships with clinicians and technicians at partner hospitals, in Denmark and nearby

• Getting into clinics and understanding how the scans are actually acquired and read

• Identifying which data holds real signal — and being honest when it does not

• Running studies and projects alongside hospital doctors

• Building prototypes that show whether a method works

Success at six months is measured in relationships and prototypes, not in shipped features.

What you will actually do

• Invent, prototype and mature algorithms for extracting clinically meaningful information from PET data

• Translate clinical and scientific questions into testable algorithmic solutions

• Build the pipelines around the work — acquisition, quality control, processing, visualisation, presentation of findings

• Go to hospitals. Observe workflows. Ask clinicians what they need and validate that your assumptions survive contact with clinical reality

• Evaluate emerging methods and tools, and shape which directions the company invests in

• Support the AI/ML dimension of medical device compliance as methods mature toward product — CE-marking and FDA

Travel is roughly two to three days per month, primarily within Denmark and southern Sweden.

Who we are looking for

Essential

• Demonstrable AI/ML development experience — applied, and with something you can point to and say “I built that”

• A software engineering and algorithm background, hands-on with PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX or Keras, and disciplined about testing and version control

• Experience with data collection, selection, integration and quality control, and preparing datasets for training

• Comfort starting from a rough idea rather than a specification

• Someone who wants to be in the room with clinicians. This role does not work from a desk — you need to be willing to initiate conversations with doctors and technicians, ask uncomfortable questions, and keep asking

• Roughly three to eight years of relevant experience. A PhD, or a PhD plus postdoc, counts — provided the work was applied and you have built things

Strongly preferred

• Medical imaging: DICOM, and work on 3D or 4D volumetric data — segmentation, registration, classification or quantification. PET, MR or X-ray all count

• PET-specific knowledge — reconstruction, attenuation and scatter correction, tracer kinetics, quantification. Genuinely valuable, genuinely not required on day one. The company expects to teach this

• Medical device software or SaMD experience — IEC 62304, quality systems, verification and validation, CE-marking or FDA

• A background in healthcare, medtech, diagnostics or another regulated field

Education

Computer science, biomedical engineering, medical physics or similar is typical. Proven capability substitutes for credentials.

Relocation

Candidates relocating to Denmark will be considered.

What this is, honestly

The genuine appeal. This is the company’s first and only AI/ML hire. Nobody has done this before you, there is no established way of working to inherit, and the direction the company takes on AI is the direction you argue for. It is an unusual amount of ownership for someone at this level, and it is the main reason to take the role.

What you should weigh. You will be the only AI/ML person among eight developers. There is no in-house peer to review your methods and no senior imaging-AI person to learn from — the clinical and scientific expertise sits with the company’s hospital collaborators and advisors rather than inside the building. Some people find that liberating. Others find it isolating, and it is worth being honest with yourself about which you are before you apply.

The other thing to weigh is the data. It is early. Expect to spend real time on access, agreements, site visits and data quality before you spend it on model architecture.

Interested, or want to know more?

Black Swans Exist is running this search exclusively. We will tell you who the company is at first conversation, and we will tell you the parts that are not in this document.

If it is not right for you but you know who it is right for, we would genuinely like to hear from you.

**Job Description

**_Do you want to make a difference in Engineering and help ensure that we deliver great customer and advisor experience?

__Do you consider software development a craft in which you take pride?

__And do you have a natural curiosity for understanding the “why” in what you do?

__If you said yes to the above, keep reading.

_We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with experience working on and integrating with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE Sales (MSD365 CE) to help build and scale our next generation Customer Engagement platform. We imagine you come from a background in general software engineering and have since specialized in, or have deep hands-on knowledge of, MSD365 CE.

**Our team

**The Customer Engagement Individuals tribe exists with the customer at the centre of everything. The tribe has ownership of key customer facing systems spanning across Danske Bank’s channels and capabilities.

The tribe are responsible for the proactive personalised advice and support in our automated and self-serviced layers of the engagement model, as well as the customer experience delivered in our digitally - and human assisted layers. Furthermore, the tooling delivered to our advisors in the expertise layer also sit with this tribe. Lastly, the entire orchestration of the engagement model including segmentation and our full MarTech stack sits within the tribe.

The tribe is composed of 13 Squads working across 7 locations (Aarhus, Copenhagen, Oslo, Stockholm, Helsinki, Vilnius and Bangalore). As this is an area of central importance to our Forward ´28 strategy you will work with best on market solutions and tools. We are in motion of implementing Chatbot based on Microsoft CoPilot Studio, CRM system based on Microsoft Dynamics Sales 365 as well as Data and AI in general are critical elements of our daily work and future.

“We value trust, collaboration, and a passion for doing things smarter – not just automagically,” says Thomas, your future Manager.

**You will:

**

• Leverage your expertise in configuration, custom development, integration engineering, and platform operations to deliver a secure and scalable CRM foundation.

• Work with other Squads to identify how existing systems can be either integrated with or entirely migrated to the CRM platform.

• In collaboration with your peers, lead and define best practices within software development in the CRM ecosystem.

• Leverage your expertise in configuration, custom development, integration engineering, and platform operations to deliver a secure and scalable CRM foundation.

• Build and maintain CRM integrations using APIs, Power Automate Cloud Flows, ADF pipelines, and Azure services.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including architects, developers, UX designers, business analysts, marketing, and sales, to align CRM solutions with business objectives.

• Solve complex problems creatively while contributing to a strong engineering culture and best practices.

• Contribute to defining how we collect and work with technical data

**About you:

**

• 
5+ years of backend engineering experience within C#, .NET

• 
3+ years of hands-on MSD365 CE experience

• 
2+ years of hands-on experience of working with relational data

• 
1+ years of TypeScript / JavaScript or equivalent frontend languages

• 
Extensive experience in building, maintaining and integrating to and from APIs

• 
Knowledgeable about Terraform (Infrastructure as code)

• 
Deep knowledge of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE ecosystem, such as

• 
Azure / DevOps, Logging & monitoring

• 
Power Automate, Apps, Plugins

• 
Dataverse

• 
Code quality is important to you and PRs are a natural part of git-ing good

• 
You know when (not) to code when working with MS D365

• 
Working agile comes naturally

• 
Advanced English language skills, written and spoken

• 
Active contributor to team goals and the support of colleagues

It is a plus – not a requirement – if you also experience with:

• Backend engineering within Java

• Native MS IAM integrations

See all the benefits HERE**.

**Your job function (position) in the job contract will be Software Engineering.

Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis. If you have questions, please reach out to Thomas Ahlgreen, Chapter Lead: thah@danskebank.dk. E-mails are checked and responded to daily.

SENIOR CONSULTANT - OCM

******Join Our Team at Devote Consulting

****Are you an experienced professional from the pharmaceutical industry, passionate about improving business processes and driving impactful change? Devote Consulting is expanding its team and is looking for a Senior Consultant with expertise in organizational change management (OCM) in the life science industry.

****Are We Looking for You?

• You thrive in the fast-paced life of consulting and enjoy sharing your knowledge and ideas

• You take ownership of your tasks, delivering high-quality work that makes a difference for people

• You have experience working with optimization of business processes and rolling out change to maximize benefits and user adoption

• You are excited about improving processes and implementing systems in Life Science R&D

• You’ll excel in our high-achieving culture, with ample opportunities for both personal and professional growth.

****What You’ll Do

****As a Senior Consultant at Devote Consulting with an OCM speciality, your key responsibilities will include:

• Supporting projects: Deliver changes in the life sciences industry focused on processes, data, and systems within R&D, clinical operations, and regulatory affairs.

• Business process optimization: (Re)design and improve business workflows for greater efficiency.

• Stakeholder management: Lead planning, change management, and foster inclusion and stakeholder management on all levels

• Driving project success: Ensure project progress and maintain high-quality standards for communication material and OCM strategies

**Your Qualifications

**We’re looking for individuals with the following qualifications:

• A master’s degree in business administration, IT, life sciences or equivalent

• 5+ years of experience as a consultant, business analyst, project manager, change lead or equivalent role in regulated industries such as Pharma, Biotech, or MedTech

• Proven analytical and problem-solving skills, with a passion for making an impact

• Experience in creating OCM strategies, as well as the execution incl. stakeholder management, training and communication material

• Fluent in English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Expertise in Clinical R&D systems (CTMS, eTMF, eSource, CDR, RBM, EDC, QMS, LIMS, etc.) and/or medical devices

• Expertise in ADKAR and a certification in OCM like PROSCI is an advantage

****What We Offer

****At Devote Consulting, we offer a position where you can take responsibility, influence outcomes, and make a difference in your everyday work. You’ll lead one or more projects as a specialist, project manager, business analyst, change lead, collaborating with clients to drive meaningful change in the pharmaceutical industry.

****Ready to Join Us?

****We welcome individuals from all backgrounds and are committed to a recruitment process that ensures equal opportunities for all applicants. We review applications on a rolling basis, so apply today!

Devote Consulting

Why this role

We are a consulting firm that helps life sciences companies, locally and globally, get their commercial data right, from master data and data platforms to customer engagement programmes. In this role, you'll be the person clients and project teams turn to when the data questions get hard.

We welcome people from two backgrounds: master data management (MDM) or data platforms. You don't need to cover both. We're looking for real depth in one.

What you'll do

• Act as the subject matter expert on MDM or data platform pre-implementation or implementations for life sciences clients, depending on your background

• Tackle the data challenges typical of customer engagement, such as HCP/HCO data quality, CRM master and reference data

• Bring third-party reference data (IQVIA, Veeva) together with client data

• Work with architects, functional consultants and client stakeholders to turn requirements into working data solutions

What you bring

• A proven track record as a subject matter expert in either:

• MDM implementations (e.g. Informatica MDM, Reltio MDM), or

• data platform implementations (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica IDMC)

• A solid understanding of data management and its typical challenges in the customer engagement (CE) domain

• A general understanding of CE processes within CRM, marketing automation, consent management, and event and engagement management

• Good knowledge of the data models of at least one key data provider: IQVIA OneKey, IQVIA sales and prescription data, or Veeva OpenData

• Clear communication, spoken and written

• Excellent English

A plus if you have

• Deep knowledge of one or more CE processes

• A certification in an MDM solution (Informatica MDM, Reltio MDM) or a data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica)

• GAMP 5 training or hands-on experience

This position is offered in Denmark and Spain.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2007, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting enterprise working exclusively in the life sciences industry.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Europe and the United States, we support clients globally. We work closely with our customers to identify, develop, and implement initiatives that drive growth, efficiency, and meaningful change. Through partnerships with leading solution providers such as Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Benchling, and MediSpend, we help our clients unlock the full potential of modern technologies.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact.

You will be part of a collaborative, high‑performing environment where:

• Ambition is encouraged through ownership and continuous learning

• Execution matters — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice

• Team spirit and trust guide collaboration across roles, countries, and disciplines

• Openness means your ideas are heard, you are challenged constructively, and supported as you grow

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

At BASE Life Science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs

By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your personal data by BASE life science for the purposes of recruitment and selection. This includes the collection, storage, and use of your personal data as outlined in our Privacy Policy.

Drive meaningful impact across the life sciences industry.

As our next Business Analyst, you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups — locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients where impact matters most.

About the role

We are seeking Business Analysts with at least 2 years of experience in implementing IT solutions in life science companies. Your main task will be to translate our pharma customers business needs into user stories and technology and to participate in implementation projects for high profile clients – from initiation to completion. The ideal candidate has successfully completed the first IT projects and is ready to specialize in delivering complex projects.

The position is placed in the Data and Analytics practice area within BASE, which combines highly specialized business knowledge of the pharma commercial domain with in-depth technology expertise to maximize the value creation from the digital platform of our clients.

Your responsibilities include:

As a minimum, we expect you to have 2 years of experience as an IT Business Analyst within life science, specifically:

• Deep hands-on understanding of the commercial processes in life science companies.

• Successful track record of participating in IT projects in a life science company.

• Proven experience in data visualization tools: Qlik (preferred), Power BI, Tableau or similar.

• Understanding of relational databases concepts and big data technologies.

• Problem solving and critical thinking mindset to support our clients’ analytics challenges and ambition to become data driven companies.

• Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

• Ability to structure tasks and sense of details.

• Ability to run workshops, documentation & customer alignments in English. French and German are a high plus!

• Strong Team spirit to contribute to project success as a great Team player.

Furthermore, the ideal candidate also has:

• A BSc or MSc from a leading university in e.g., computer science, information technology, or engineering or similar experience.

• Practical experience with agile and waterfall project management.

• Proven experience with implementing cloud solutions.

• Understanding of GxP is a plus.

• Knowledge of Veeva, IQVIA and/or Salesforce solutions is a plus.

• Ability to structure and present complex situations to a set of various stakeholders including executive levels

Lastly, we expect you to be willing to continuously build knowledge in the IT solutions and business areas where BASE is a leader, as we desire like-minded people who are curious and constantly seek new knowledge.

This position is offered in Spain (Madrid or Barcelona) or Denmark (Copenhagen)

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2015, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting company working exclusively in life sciences, built on a simple purpose: grow our people, and deliver real impact for our customers.

We don't think AI is a feature you bolt onto existing systems — we think it's the layer through which a life sciences company's strategy actually gets executed, end to end. Most of the industry is still proving AI can do one task at a time, function by function, pilot by pilot. We're building toward something bigger: AI that runs across clinical, regulatory, quality, and commercial work instead of stopping at the edges of a single application.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Spain, Switzerland, the UK, Germany, France, Italy, and the US, we work with top-10 pharma and ambitious biotechs alike, and with technology partners including Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Google, AWS, Microsoft, and Amass — turning that belief into deployed, compliant, sellable solutions, not slideware.

Why join BASE life science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact — grounded in five core values: team spirit, trust, openness, ambition, and execution.

Minerva’s CDMO is looking for a new addition to the team. We are looking for a (Senior) Scientist with a background in radiochemistry and/or analytical chemistry to contribute to development work within our CDMO.

The position is within a dynamic and multidisciplinary team that develops manufacturing and analytical setups for targeted radionuclide therapies. This necessitates close collaboration with our scientists and technicians across the organization. It is essential that you are a good team player and have excellent communication skills, are efficient and have an eye for detail to maintain the high quality of data we are known for.

The ideal candidate will be a PhD level radiochemist with prior experience in CMC and GMP. But the most important thing is interest, a quick mind, and a willingness to learn.

You will be part of an experienced team, and your role will include a wide range of responsibilities:

• Development of robust production setup, including material selection, process design and process descriptions

• Development of analytical setup

• Engage with clients regarding development activities

• Synthesis setup and automation on dedicated synthesis modules

• Validation of processes and analytical methods

• Equipment qualification

All within a new and expanding GMP clean room facility

Qualifications:

• Ideally a PhD in radiochemistry, radiopharmacy, analytical chemistry

• While prior experience in radiochemistry is not mandatory, a willingness and aptitude to learn are essential.

• Experience in analytical method development, validation, and lifecycle management in a GMP-regulated environment.

• 3+ years relevant experience in an academic or industrial environment.

As a person, you:

• Are a team player, committed, organized, curious and adaptable to change.

• Can influence and interact with multiple stakeholders across levels and disciplines.

• Thrive in a fast-paced and service-oriented organization.

• Have strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Danish is an advantage.

Minerva offers:

We believe in creating an agile working environment, so we have flexible working options including the option of working from home. We care about our employees’ well-being and offer health insurance and a quality conscious lunch scheme and monthly social activities.

We are an informal organization with a strong focus on open and honest communication. We value humour and a natural care for one another.

Application:

Please submit your application no later than October 30th 2026. The application must include a motivated cover letter and a CV addressing the listed qualifications. Applications will be evaluated continuously, and the position will be filled as soon as the right candidate has been identified.

If you have questions regarding the position, please contact Head of Production Kent Dahm Nørgaard at KEN@minervaimaging.com or Head of QC Palle Rasmussen at PAR@minervaimaging.com

About Minerva Imaging:

Minerva Imaging is a scientifically driven and fully integrated Contract Research Organization (CRO) and Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) specializing in targeted radionuclide therapies.

We support translational research and drug development through the use of advanced preclinical animal models within oncology and cardiovascular diseases, combined with state-of-the-art in vivo molecular imaging. By working in close partnership with our sponsors, we seek to understand their scientific challenges and jointly identify how our expertise, technologies, and methods can deliver robust and meaningful answers.

Our modern facility in Ølstykke, Denmark offers best-in-class, fully integrated radiopharmaceutical research, development, and manufacturing capabilities—covering the entire value chain from early research to clinical supply.

Backed by Nordic Capital since 2026, Minerva Imaging is executing an ambitious growth strategy aimed at strengthening our position as a market leader within targeted radionuclide therapies. This growth journey offers exciting opportunities for individuals who want to contribute to cutting-edge science in a dynamic and international environment.

Minerva Imaging is an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of background or experience. In accordance with our recruitment policy, all candidates are required to provide a personal criminal record as part of the hiring process.

Follow us on LinkedIn for the latest news updates or visit www.minervaimaging.com for more information.

jobs.occupation: A Post doc position is available in the Grønbæk Group at Biotech Research and Innovation Centre (BRIC),
jobs.description:
We are searching for a skilled and experienced post doc with specific interest in investigating early myeloid disease, clonal haematopoiesis, metabolism and obesity.

Our research/The group

The focus of the Grønbæk group is Translational Haematology. The group is affiliated with Biotech Research and Innovation centre (BRIC), University of Copenhagen and Rigshospitalet (Central Copenhagen University Hospital).

Our overall aim is to understand the molecular mechanisms of haematological cancers and based on this; to design, develop and implement novel, scientifically based, clinical trials, with a strong focus on epigenetic therapies. This is done by bridging between clinical research at Rigshospitalet and the basic cancer biology research at BRIC, and in international collaborations with, among others, the Van Andel Research Institute, Michigan, USA and the Nordic MDS study group.

Our location at the Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC provides optimal conditions for interaction with the basic scientists at BRIC. The group currently consists of 14 scientists, MD/scientists and students, one clinical research coordinator, 1 research nurse and 2 biomedical laboratory scientists.

The project: Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms.

The current position is part of a joint project ‘Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms’ together with Professor George Vassiliou, Cambridge Stem Cell Institute, University of Cambridge, United Kingdom funded by a ‘Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC)’ grant from the Novo Nordisk foundation, which supports collaborative research projects with the purpose ‘t_o reverse-translate clinical observations into mechanistic studies that will increase our understanding of how obesity impacts carcinogenesis’.

Obesity is a global health issue linked to increased risk of cancer, including blood cancers such as myeloid neoplasms (MN). Many MN arise from clonal haematopoiesis (CH)—the abnormal expansion of blood stem cell clones carrying somatic mutations. Haematopoietic stem cells interact with bone marrow adipose tissue (BMAT), which increases with obesity, which may fuel CH growth and progression to MN. Epidemiological and genetic studies already suggest obesity accelerates CH, but the underlying mechanisms remain unclear.

This project integrates large-scale population data, clinical trials, and mechanistic mouse studies to investigate these links and explore preventive or therapeutic strategies.

Your job

The project focuses on translational analyses of live frozen human cells from patient bone marrow (BM)/(BMAT) and blood samples from completed and ongoing clinical trials. We are searching for a skilled post doc who is very interactive and enjoys collaborations with other scientists – including younger scientists and clinician scientists.

Your tasks will include:

• Process of live frozen patient material from clinical trials including isolation of defined cell populations, and quality control for downstream omics

• Perform in-house molecular techniques which may include Proteomics, PCR, ddPCR, and library/sample preparation for RNA-seq, ATAC-seq and DNA methylation analyses

• Coordinate genomic, transcriptomic, lipidomic, metabolomic analyses with our internal and external collaborating laboratories and take the lead on designing relevant sub-studies, integrating and interpreting the data

• Help establish the practical and regulatory framework for these collaborations, including material transfer and data-sharing agreements

• Participate in grant and manuscript writing

• Present at local and international meetings

• Introduce lab techniques to new lab members and students

• Collaborate with both scientists and clinicians

Start: February 1st, 2027

Duration: 2 years

Profile

We expect you to be a highly motivated and highly ambitious, independent scientist with the following qualifications: •

• A PhD in Life Sciences with a preferred focus on haematology

• A strong background in mechanisms of normal and malignant haematopoiesis and molecular haematology techniques

• Comprehensive lab skills in molecular and cellular biology techniques, including work with primary human cells and cryopreserved patient material

• Experience with genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, lipidomics, metabolomics and ability to analyse and interpret such data

• Experience with running projects across research groups

• Strong publication and presentation record in peer reviewed journals and international conferences

• Excellent written and spoken English skills

• Very collaborative

• Good social skills

Place of employment

The workplace is at the Bartholin Institute which is part of Rigshospitalet, University of Copenhagen. The Bartholin Institute is located at Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC, close to the centre of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and a number of core facilities (animal unit, flow cytometry, in vivo imaging, NGS, etc.) shared between the research groups at BRIC (www.bric.ku.dk) and the neighbouring Finsen Laboratory. We have weekly journal clubs, data clubs, seminars with invited speakers and a young researchers club ASAP and our own PhD programme, MoMeD.

Terms of employment

The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of two years. The starting date is 01.02.2027 or after agreement.

Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 39,900 DKK/approx. 5,300 EUR (August 2026 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18,07 % to your pension fund.

Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025

Questions

For further information regarding the position, please contact Professor Kirsten Grønbæk, kirsten groenbaek@regionh.dk; phone + 4535456086 / +4525211598.

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Application

The application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page).

2. CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position.

3. A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do.

4. List of publications.

Recommendation

Furthermore, the applicant should provide two letters of recommendation or two references. To be taken into consideration, the letters must be signed by the supporting person on paper with institutional letter head and in PDF-format.

Application deadline 15 November 2026, 23.59pm CET.

We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications 3 of 4 or letters of recommendation that do not live up to the above-mentioned requirements.

The further process

After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

jobs.occupation: PhD in Light-Activated Micromotors for Biomedical Applications - DTU Health Tech
jobs.description:
If you are interested in pursuing a PhD at the interface of micro/nanotechnology, biomaterials, and biomedical engineering and want to work on a highly interdisciplinary and clinically relevant challenge, this position offers a unique opportunity.

At DTU Health Tech, within the interdisciplinary IDUN research section, you will develop near-infrared (NIR) light-activated micromotors for biomedical applications, with a focus on Hidradenitis Suppurativa (HS). You will work at the interface of micro/nanotechnology, functional materials, biomaterials, and disease modelling, investigating how active micromotor propulsion can overcome transport barriers in complex and confined biological environments.

Responsibilities and qualifications
The main purpose of this PhD project is to develop NIR-responsive micromotors and investigate their active transport within biomimetic models of HS tunnel architecture.

You will design and fabricate biodegradable Janus micromotors and develop three-dimensional hydrogel-based models that reproduce key geometrical features of HS tunnels. You will investigate how micromotor properties and geometric confinement influence active transport and compare propulsion-driven transport with passive particle behaviour.

Your primary tasks will be to:

• Design and fabricate NIR-responsive Janus micromotors with controlled size and surface properties
• Characterize micromotor morphology, optical and photothermal properties, stability, and biodegradability
• Evaluate NIR-activated micromotor propulsion in controlled and skin-relevant environments
• Develop 3D hydrogel-based models mimicking the confined architecture of HS tunnels
• Design channel geometries with different dimensions, branches, and bifurcations to investigate micromotor transport under geometric confinement
• Quantify micromotor penetration, transport velocity, and navigation through confined channel systems
• Compare active micromotor transport with passive diffusion and non-propelled particle controls
• Disseminate research findings through scientific publications, international conferences, and collaborative activities
Qualifications
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree, in nanotechnology, chemistry, materials science, biomedical engineering, pharmaceutical sciences, biotechnology, or a closely related field.

You should have a strong interest in micro- and nanotechnology and hands-on experimental research. Experience with particle fabrication, functional materials, surface modification, microscopy, microfabrication, or biomaterials is highly desirable. Experience with light-responsive or photothermal materials, micromotors, hydrogel fabrication, microfluidic systems, or quantitative particle tracking is considered an advantage.

You are a highly motivated and curious researcher who enjoys experimental work and interdisciplinary problem-solving. You should be interested in combining materials science and micro/nanotechnology with biomedical applications and in understanding how active microscale systems interact with complex and confined biological environments. You should be comfortable working both independently and collaboratively within an interdisciplinary research team.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years. The starting date is 1 February 2027 or according to mutual agreement. The position is a full-time position.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Assistant Professor Tijana Miseljic, tijma@dtu.dk, and Professor Anja Boisen, aboi@dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 3 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• Publication list
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Health Tech
With a vision to improve health and quality of life through technology, DTU Health Tech engages in research, education, and innovation based on technical and natural science. We educate tomorrow’s health tech engineers and create the foundation for new and innovative services and technologies for the globally expanding healthcare sector with its demands for the most advanced technological solutions. DTU Health Tech’s expertise can be described through five overall research areas: Diagnostic Imaging, Digital Health, Personalised Therapy, Precision Diagnostics, and Sensory and Neural Technology. Our technologies and solutions are developed with the aim of benefiting people and creating value for society. The department has a scientific staff of about 210 persons, 140 PhD Students, and a technical/administrative support staff of about 100 persons of which a large majority contributes to our research infrastructure and related commercial activities.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

Job Description:

Are you a strategic thinker who can bridge the gap between complex business goals and a high-performing IT landscape? We are looking for an Enterprise Architect to take ownership of our architectural vision and governance. In this role, you will be the guardian of our IT integrity, ensuring that every new initiative accelerates our digital transformation while staying true to our core principles.

As the owner of the Enterprise Architecture (EA) governance process, you will provide the framework that evaluates IT projects and aligns them with our long-term strategy.

**What The Job Is

**The Enterprise Architect is the strategic owner of the EA governance process. You will anticipate long-term business needs and ensure that Satair's IT model is perfectly synchronized with our organizational policies and strategies. By providing structured leadership, you will gain consensus from the management team on critical IT policy decisions, from platform selection to technology strategies, that support our overarching goals.

Your primary responsibilities:

• Process Ownership & Governance: Own the formal approach for implementing solutions. You will manage the "two-step funneling" methodology to screen new initiatives for strategic, cross-cutting, or architectural impact.

• Design Patterns & Models: Develop and promote standardized design patterns and models to ensure consistent application design and a resilient, scalable architecture across the enterprise.

• Principle Custodianship: Act as the lead custodian of Satair’s signature architecture principles, ensuring every solution adheres to these guidelines.

• Strategic Alignment & SLAs: Ensure that all IT solutions are strictly aligned with business needs and are designed to meet or exceed established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• Documentation & Repository Management: Finalize and transfer EA-approved documents to the central repository, ensuring the Architecture Board has clear, high-quality materials for final review.

• Financial Stewardship: Produce detailed cost/benefit analyses for new technology implementations, providing the data necessary for informed investment decisions.

• Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify where software, applications, or processes need to evolve to meet the needs of tomorrow’s aviation market.

**How You Will Contribute To The Team

**The Enterprise Architect reports directly to the Head of CIO Office. In this pivotal position, you serve as a key bridge between our strategic vision and the technical execution of the IT organization. You will have a leading role in the architecture landscape, acting as the primary driver for the Architecture Board. Your work ensures that the integrity of our current technology is protected while we build the capabilities required for a secure, resilient, and sustainable future.

We are looking for a seasoned professional with a deep background in IT strategy and architecture governance. You should have a proven ability to lead through influence, gaining commitment from senior management for major technology shifts.

What you bring to the table:

• Architectural Excellence: A proven track record in developing resilient architecture models and reusable design patterns.

• Strategic Insight: The ability to perform cost/benefit evaluations that justify strategic technology choices to the CIO office and IT Management.

• Operational Focus: A commitment to ensuring technical solutions deliver on business promises and operational SLAs.

• Collaborative Leadership: Experience with EA frameworks (such as TOGAF) and the ability to navigate complex governance funnels with multiple stakeholders.

Beyond technical expertise, you are a master of communication. You can take a complex organizational challenge and translate it into a structured architectural solution. If you are ready to own the blueprint for Satair’s digital future, we’d love to hear from you.

Beyond technical skills, we value individuals who bring a collaborative mindset, excellent communication abilities, and the confidence to interact with stakeholders at all levels.

In this team, we prioritize innovation, problem-solving, and proactive thinking. If you are passionate about securing the future of aviation and enjoy working in an environment that values your expertise, we’d love to hear from you.

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At Satair, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

jobs.occupation: Data Center Technician II, Global Server Operations
jobs.description:
**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience in diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols.

• Experience with performing component-level repairs on IT equipment.

• Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and to exert physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.

• Must have the ability to work non-standard hours, including weekends, holidays and on shift-based schedule as required.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Certification in online Google IT Support Professional Certificate program.

• 2 years of experience in diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols.

• Experience in working within a data center or network operation center environment.

• Ability to collaborate and partner with teams to overcome tests.

• Ability to adapt to changes in a changing work environment.

About the jobGoogle isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.600000 - kr.615000 (DKK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or functions.

• Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose straightforward issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and apply the resources needed to resolve identified issues.

• Maintain the security and integrity of data, track various forms of media to check for standard data security issues (e.g., data was not properly erased) handled in accordance with Google security standards.

• Disassemble specific equipment that has reached its end-of-life via part replacement or maintenance, in a team setting.

• Repair, fix, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, or infrastructure based on identified issues with defined solutions.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

About the role

We are looking for Senior DevOps engineer with deep expertise in CI/CD to join our Platform Engineering team in Copenhagen.

This role is focused on modernizing how software is built, tested, packaged, delivered, and deployed across Keepit. You will help define the standards, tooling, and practices that engineering teams across the company use to build and deliver software.

Experience designing CI/CD solutions for multiple teams and working effectively with the engineers who use them is essential for this role.

You will:

• 
Build reusable GitLab CI/CD components and pipelines used across engineering teams.

• 
Build and operate highly available platform services and engineering infrastructure, including AWX, HashiCorp Vault, Terraform-based infrastructure, and other services depended on by engineering teams. Our infrastructure spans Proxmox and Kubernetes.

• 
Create clear, durable documentation that helps engineers understand how our platform works, why decisions were made, and how to use it effectively.

• 
Operate the runner infrastructure used to build, test, and deploy our software, keeping it reliable, efficient, and secure.

• 
Build automated tests and validation that allow us to upgrade and change the platform with confidence.

About you

Must-haves:

• 
Strong Linux fundamentals, particularly with Debian-based systems and APT.

• 
Deep understanding of CI/CD concepts and experience designing and maintaining pipelines; GitLab CI/CD experience is preferred.

• 
Hands-on experience with several of the technologies we use, including containers, Bash, Ansible, Kubernetes, and observability stacks such as LGTM.

• 
Experience designing tooling, pipelines, or infrastructure used by multiple engineering teams.

• 
Experience operating and evolving production systems, with the engineering judgment that comes from learning what works and what doesn't.

• 
Excellent communication skills in English.

• 
You work carefully and conscientiously, particularly when making changes to systems that other engineers depend on.

Nice-to-haves:

• 
Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs, routing, DHCP, and firewalling.

• 
Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools effectively, particularly for development, operations, documentation, or knowledge sharing.

• 
A passion for creating a great developer experience.

• 
Personal projects, open-source contributions, homelabs, or other evidence of technical curiosity outside your primary responsibilities.

About us

Our platform provides customers with an immutable, historical archive of their data in systems such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, Entra ID, Dynamics 365, and Zendesk. We protect our customers against everything, from ransomware to simple accidents. We pride ourselves on backing up hundreds of petabytes of data in a performant, reliable, and predictable way.

As we collaborate across locations, English is our primary language. Please submit your CV in English to support the review process.

We offer:

• 
Competitive salary.

• 
Pension scheme.

• 
A modern, energetic global work environment.

• 
Flexible work-life balance supported by a hybrid working model.

• 
Regular team-building activities.

• 
Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

• 
Compensation is based on experience and skill set.

We kindly ask you not to provide us with any sensitive categories of personal data when applying for a job with us. When applying for the vacancy, Keepit will process your personal data, and therefore we recommend that you also read our privacy policy, which describes our processing of personal data and your rights as a data subject.

Wokshop – A Bite of Thailand is all about authentic Thai flavors, fresh ingredients, and a relaxed dining experience.
